chunks: Except those who believe and do the right, and remember God a great deal, who retaliate only when they have been wronged. Yet the oppressors will now come to know through what reversals they will be overthrown!
ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics of believers mentioned in Surah Al-Shu'ara verse 227?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as defining the ideal believer who combines spiritual devotion with active social justice, particularly emphasizing the concept of 'intiqam' (vindication) not merely as personal revenge but as the establishment of equity after oppression. The mention of 'remembering God abundantly' (dhikr) is linked to the inner spiritual strength that sustains believers during their struggle, while the warning to oppressors reflects the inevitable divine retribution described in the afterlife. This verse serves as a bridge between individual piety and communal resilience, a theme central to the narrative of the Ahl al-Bayt.
